domains.coverage: 13 Scout order traces and six initial land inventory cases match recorded original behavior. Four inventory source cases exchange only an installed TECH token. Shipped unit/component/morale-name tables, concrete faction TECH tokens, native conventional/civilian metadata, construction and startup handoff are exercised separately by native/application tests and real browser source swaps, natural Former completion and normal growth/Pod construction. Installed TERRAIN metadata, native work-state persistence and live terrain edits now have separate headless and browser checks, including world/preview redraws under two rule profiles. Production work commands and fresh-turn progress now support one healthy normal Former on flat arid non-base land; six frozen work traces match native replay. Original combat odds and complete research/terraforming/AI remain unimplemented. Six independently repeated original Former traces are frozen (edited mine completion, farm cancellation/resume, held-out ordinary Road/edited Forest, retained-work switching and accepted Farm-to-Forest replacement); candidate replay matches all six; they are promoted into the passing catalog. Three additional repeated original road traces establish three road steps per turn, work after one or two steps, retained same-year cancellation, exhausted same-task resume without extra work, and next-turn cancellation. Installed RULES road rates and actual native movement/rollback have application tests; alternate rates are not original observations. Two held-out timing traces add first-year Farm cancellation/resume with retained work/exhausted movement and completion under an edited Road work rate. Both initially checked against the frozen candidate; the Farm refund mismatch is fixed without changing earlier observations. Two further repeated original road-network traces cover implicit base entry/exit with its explicit road flag clear and three steps through non-base forest roads. Moist/rainy/rocky profiles remain unobserved; a supplied moist map was changed during original startup and is excluded from passing evidence.
